claims.claim: OpenAI will start watermarking eligible text from ChatGPT and Codex in the EU over the coming weeks.
claims.episode_span: OpenAI announced it will start adding special hidden markers called text watermarks to some of the writing that ChatGPT and its other tools produce.
claims.supporting_quote: Over the coming weeks, we will add an invisible watermark to eligible ChatGPT and Codex text output in the European Union.

claims.claim: TikTok added a conversational AI shopping assistant with one-click checkout.
claims.episode_span: TikTok just added a conversational AI agent inside its app that can help you find products, answer questions about them, and even let you check out with one tap.
claims.source_title: TikTok rolls out an AI shopping assistant and one-click checkout
claims.supporting_quote: TikTok describes its new Shopping Assistant as a conversational AI agent designed to help users discover and purchase products.

claims.episode_span: Instinct is rolling out group chats where multiple people can work together with the same AI agent on tasks like planning a trip, organizing a carpool, or setting up an event.
claims.supporting_quote: Instinct is launching group chats that let friends use its AI agent together for tasks like planning trips
